description: AI‑enhanced, zero‑dependency Node.js framework that outpaces Express & Fastify with instant edge deployment, built‑in zero‑trust security, and type‑safe routing.
npm_trending_strategy: Version 0.0.133‑daily leverages the 2026 AI‑code‑assist trend: the core router is generated on‑the‑fly by an integrated LLM, giving you type‑safe endpoints without writing boilerplate. Zero external dependencies keep the bundle < 5 KB, perfect for edge runtimes (Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge, Bun, Deno). Built‑in zero‑trust policies, CSP, rate‑limiting and JWT auth replace dozens of middleware packages, delivering out‑of‑the‑box security that Express/Fastify lack. Instant one‑click deployment scripts let you push to any edge platform in seconds, positioning yantravese as the go‑to framework for AI‑first, serverless micro‑apps.
download_hooks: Developers choose yantravese because it eliminates the entire middleware ecosystem—security, rate‑limiting, and auth are native, letting you ship production‑grade services instantly.
Benchmarks show up to 3× lower latency than Express on edge runtimes, thanks to a zero‑dependency core and compiled‑time type‑safe routing.
The integrated LLM‑driven router generator cuts boilerplate by 80 %, and the VS Code extension with Copilot support provides instant autocomplete for routes, middlewares, and security policies.
